description: Installations de production et de stockage d'électricité dans les Hautes-Pyrénées (au 31/12/2024) is a dataset listed in portail Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Agence ORE. Ce jeu de données correspond à l'extrait du registre national produit par l'agence ORE qui présente les installations de production et de stockage d'électricité raccordées directement ou indirectement aux réseaux publics d’électricité en France métropolitaine et dans les zones non interconnectées (ZNI) au 31 décembre 2024. Coverage: Hautes-Pyrénées. The portal files it under Territoire. The portal shows 684 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-01-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-ha-py-fr-portal.
